shortDescription: Module for setup of WebappUT Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: Cloud of the webapput object-level0. It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Field introduced in 30.2.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: default_fifth_int
options.description: Default int32 field. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.

options.name: default_first_int
options.description: Default uint64 field. Field introduced in 30.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: default_fourth_int
options.description: Default int32 field. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: default_string
options.description: Default string field. Field introduced in 30.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as default string.

options.name: mandatory_test
options.description: Optional message for nested f_mandatory test cases defined at level1. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: mandatory_tests
options.description: Repeated message for nested f_mandatory test cases-level1. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the webapput object-level0. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: sensitive_test
options.description: Optional message for nested f_sensitive test cases defined at level1. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: sensitive_tests
options.description: Repeated message for nested f_sensitive test cases-level1. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: skip_optional_check_tests
options.description: Optional bool for nested skip_optional_check test cases-level1. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: string_length_test
options.description: Optional message for nested  max string length test cases. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: string_length_tests
options.description: Repeated message for nested  max string length test cases. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant of the webapput object-level0. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: test_sensitive_string
options.description: The string for sensitive (secret) field. Object-level0. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: test_string
options.description: The maximum string length. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the webapput object-level0. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
